mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT k.*, c.cat_name FROM knowledge k LEFT JOIN knowledge_category c ON k.cat_id = c.cat_id WHERE k.know_id = #{articleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE know_id = #{articleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge (cat_id, title, content, cover, status, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge SET cat_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, cover = #{coverImage}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE know_id = #{articleId}
